patch_description:
This version keeps the effective-size threshold formulation, but improves feasibility detection near the binary-search boundary. Greedy bin packing can falsely reject a feasible threshold because of fragmentation. The new implementation tries several greedy orders and, when they fail, performs a bounded symmetry-pruned backtracking repair over the final models. For small instances it can search the complete effective-size packing directly.

It also retains multiple greedy KVPR seeds and applies move/swap local search to every feasible candidate, selecting the placement with the lowest maximum KVPR. All returned placements are concretely memory-feasible.
